description: Phase 3b (A20): the user entity as GET /me, /sync/bootstrap and /sync changes present it. 'fields' must all be present; 'never' must never appear. city and country_code are labels the user typed or picked (never GPS); avatar_version counts photo changes (0 = never had one); has_avatar is true while a photo exists (false after removal, so other devices show initials without asking). Readers tolerate any of the 3b fields being absent (an older server) and unknown extras. A39 (Phase 5.1): xp, level, progress_into_level, next_level_threshold and freeze_balance moved to the reward_state entity; auto_freeze stays.
